create_EQAEpisode: create an EQAEpisode with question data including question text, answer text, and tokenized question tokens
build_QuestionSensor: build a QuestionSensor that returns tokenized question tokens from an EQAEpisode as observations
implement_AnswerAccuracy: implement an AnswerAccuracy measure that compares the agent answer against the episode correct answer token
run_EQATask: run an EQATask navigation episode where the agent navigates then submits an answer via AnswerAction
review_AnswerAction: review the AnswerAction class that registers an answer action with discrete answer ID action space
